title: CorpusRelease embedding manifest (embedding-manifest.json)
description: The bundle's second manifest — PRD §18.4 lists embedding-manifest.json in the fixed release layout. Basis: PRD §17.2 tiers, §17.3 'Offline/local: document embeddings', §35.3 chunk_embedding columns (profile_id, dimensions, quantisation), §14.4 'Embedding changes require a dual index, retrieval recall/resource comparison and pointer rollback', and breakdown plan §8 Q11 for model_revision, model_artifact, licence, the tokenizer artefact identity and runtime. CRPS-05 emits the instance; this member list and CRPS-05's deliverable 4 list must remain identical — on divergence THIS SCHEMA WINS and the divergence is a writeback. Consumers that transcribe this list (RETR-05, RETR-07) update their transcription through their own module's ticket; they never edit this schema.

manifest_version.description: Contract versioning (PRD §45.4); the schema directory is v<major>, exactly as for the release manifest.

profile_id.description: chunk_embedding.profile_id (PRD §35.3) — the embedding profile the vectors belong to. Must equal the release manifest's embedding_profile.profile_id.

model_id.description: The model that produced the vectors (value is breakdown plan §8 Q2, benchmark-selected). A value marked as a stub ('stub' or 'stub:<seed>', the CRPS-05 deliverable 2 convention) is BLOCKING for a CANDIDATE or PUBLISHED release.

model_revision.description: Breakdown plan §8 Q11 'immutable revision identifier' — a mutable tag is not acceptable.

model_artifact.description: Q11 'hash' — the artefact identity RETR-07 verifies before executing it.

licence.description: Q11 'licence information'; PRD §11.1's conservative default applies to weights as it does to sources.

tokenizer.description: Q11 'a local tokenizer.json pinned by the release' — the artefact hash makes the pin checkable.

dimensions.description: chunk_embedding.dimensions (PRD §35.3). Query vectors that do not match this cannot match the indexed vectors.

normalisation.description: Q11 'normalisation' — the vector normalisation applied before indexing.

distance_metric.description: The metric the vector index was built for; a consumer that searches with a different metric silently returns wrong neighbours.

runtime.description: Breakdown plan §8 Q11 runtime pin — the runtime the embeddings were produced with. Must agree member-for-member with the release manifest's runtime.

builder_version.description: The version of the embedding pipeline that produced the vectors.

input_contract_version.description: The corpus/intermediate contract version the embedding pass consumed.

tier_selection.description: PRD §17.2 tiers — which chunk tiers were embedded, and how many chunks were embedded or skipped. PRD §14.4 requires an embedding change to be comparable, which requires knowing what was embedded.

tiers.description: The PRD §17.2 tiers included in this embedding pass.

vector_file.description: The vector index file this manifest describes — PRD §18.4's vectors.usearch. Its sha256 is cross-checked against the release manifest's files[] and artifacts.vector_index_sha256.

path.description: Bundle-root-relative POSIX path of the vector file.

byte_size.description: Size of the vector file in bytes.

determinism.description: Whether the embedding pass is reproducible, and the seed it used. PRD §14.4 makes an embedding change a comparison exercise, which is only meaningful against a reproducible baseline.

seed.description: The seed used, or null when the pass takes none.

deterministic.description: Whether re-running the pass on the same inputs reproduces the same vectors.

source_release_id.description: The release whose chunks were embedded, when the pass ran against an existing release; null when the embedding pass is part of the release being built.
